source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Friendly **FOETID BLOAT-DRONE** units, **FOETID BLOAT-DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER** units, **HELBRUTE** units and **MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER** units gain the **CONTAGION ENGINE** keyword. Ranged attacks made by friendly **CONTAGION ENGINE** units have **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)**. The detachment carries the **ENGINES** tag, so no other **ENGINES** detachment can be taken alongside it.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 273 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
